description: Type the 409 a fork gets before the source sandbox has a completed snapshot: {"code": "fork_failed", "message": "Fork needs a completed snapshot. Snapshots are made periodically and again when a Sandbox stops."}. Observed live 2026-11-07.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The sandbox has no completed snapshot to fork from yet. Snapshots are made periodically and when a sandbox stops; retry later.
